svg.title: EV choice experiment · From explanation to held-out choice prediction
svg.desc: Proposed extension · not performed. Keep interpretable choice models as the benchmark; add ML only if it improves a genuine prediction task. Proposed workflow. No new data or model results are claimed.

g.text: From explanation to held-out choice prediction

path.title: Recover task design → Logit + boosted trees

g.title: Recover alternatives, coding, price units, respondent IDs and the experimental design. Reproduce the existing utility and willingness-to-pay calculations first.
Compare the choice specifications with a choice-set-aware boosted-tree ranking baseline. Each prediction must account for all alternatives available in that task.
Keep every task from a respondent in one fold. Compare held-out choice log loss, probability calibration and uncertainty; fit preprocessing only within training folds.
Test transportability with a separately recruited buyer sample. Observed purchase follow-up would be a distinct outcome; do not equate intention, stated choice and purchase.
